name: Republic of Ezo (1869)
description: A white field bearing the republic's round red seal inscribed with the characters of the Hakodate government.
history: Flag of the Republic of Ezo, the short-lived state proclaimed on Hokkaido by Tokugawa loyalists after the Boshin War — often called Japan's first republic, its leaders elected by ballot. It surrendered to imperial forces in June 1869 after five months.
